prompt: Rebalance $5,000 into whatever is underweight across my portfolio. I want the skill to read my current positions, figure out what's under its target allocation, and propose tickers.

assertions.text: YAML frontmatter contains all 11 required fields
Execution Summary table contains at least 2 ticker rows (not a single-ticker deployment)
Sum of dollar amounts equals $5,000 within ±$0.01
Strategy Rationale references specific current portfolio weights (by ticker or layer) — not generic 'market conditions'
Each selected ticker has rationale tying it to an underweight category or gap
Framework citation present (likely margin-strategy.md or cashflow-policy.md)
